text:
anika: kicking off cloud marketplace listing for merchant-acct-42. need to confirm networking/KMS + trial entitlement mapping. pinging legal + infra.

mike: noted. target regions are us-west-2 and europe-west1. prefer to mirror our supported regions.

jen: legal check — we need localized EULA + a short trial terms snippet. can someone drop proposed trial wording? clarify seat-based vs usage limits.

anika: proposed trial: 14-day full access, capped at 10k tokens/day and 5 concurrent sessions. sample wording i put in drive: https://go/internal/marketplace/trial-text (placeholder)

samir: infra notes: for AWS listing we need VPC peering details or a published connector. also need publisher IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublish and confirmation whether merchant wants Customer-Managed KMS. if CMK, need their account-id + key ARN.

mike: merchant prefers CMK. account id they gave: 987654321000. i'll request key ARNs and share when received.

jen: also require trademark attestation + marketing assets (SVG, 2x PNG) and license_summary.pdf. ask them to confirm they have redistribution rights for bundled docs.

anika: building the asset manifest now. planned fields: am i_id, container_image_sha, logo_{svg,png}, license_summary.pdf, trial_policy.md, sku_crosswalk.csv

marketplace-bot: checklist created for thread 1749987654: [1] Asset manifest draft, [2] AMI/container verification, [3] KMS ARNs, [4] EULA localization, [5] SKU mapping, [6] Legal attestation, [7] Publish role verification, [8] Marketing blurb. Status: awaiting items 2,3,4,6.

samir: ops question — do we want a free-tier SKU for early access? if yes, mapping will create a billing rule and trial entitlement in the manifest.

mike: yes, map free-tier -> SKU_FREE_TRIAL in manifest. we also need a GCP/Azure equivalent label in sku_crosswalk.csv. i'll prep that.

jen: for EULA localization we'll need legal owner signoff per region. i'll add a signoff column to the manifest. @lina can you draft two storefront blurbs for the listing (short + long)?

lina: sure — will post drafts in the drive by EOD and tag this thread.

anika: scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize asset manifest, confirm KMS ARNs, and lock SKU mapping. calendar invite sent. agenda in invite.

mike: ack — i'll have KMS ARNs and initial sku_crosswalk.csv by the sync.

jen: ack — legal will review the EULA drafts before the meeting. adding signoff milestone to the invite.

anika: thanks everyone. closing loop: if anyone uploads docs after the meeting, please ping and i'll update the marketplace checklist. :thumbsup:
